label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verse: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
note: From the psalm David gave when the ark came to Jerusalem — it reappears almost word for word in Psalm 96.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in _____ resting places;
verse: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
note: A promise of peaceable homes, sure dwellings, and quiet resting places — real rest, at last.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a _____.
verse: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
note: Jeremiah's excuse when God called: 'I am a child' — God's answer was, don't say that, just go.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of _____ life.
verse: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
note: When many disciples walked away, Peter answered for the Twelve: there's nowhere else worth going.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou, O LORD, _____ for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verse: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
note: Lamentations ends among ruins, but this verse stands: 'Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.'
